meaning: SHA1 of the boundary geometry, first 12 hex. One physical field.
Cash crop harvest year. Rows are aligned to this.
County and state from the Fieldprint payload.
Boundary centroid rounded to 0.1 deg (~11 km). Deliberately coarse.
Area of the boundary as the pipeline measured it.
Plantable acres as entered in Fieldprint.
single unit | trim | split. Whether the outline holds one management unit.
Area flagged as disagreeing with the rest of the boundary.
Cloud-free Sentinel-2 observations in that calendar year.
Dominant USDA CDL class for the crop year.
Share of the boundary the dominant class covers. Under 75 is a weak boundary.
Distinct CDL classes inside the boundary.
Share of the boundary CDL calls non-cropland.
ESTIMATED from the NDVI curve. Never validated against a grower record.
Uncertainty window, set by the gaps between clear images.
Harvest minus planting, both estimated.
Highest fitted NDVI in the season and when.
Fitted floor and the rise above it.
Clear observations the season fit used.
high | medium | low, with the reason when low.
The off-season PRECEDING this crop year, e.g. 2025-26 on crop year 2026.
Off-season window actually scored.
Clear observations inside that window. Below ~10 the verdict is weak.
Peak off-season NDVI. The threshold CC_GREEN_MIN = 0.30 acts on this.
Mean off-season NDVI.
Days the daily-interpolated curve sits above 0.30.
likely | possible | green cover | none | winter cash crop | not detectable.
Why the verdict is what it is.
Pre-planting window: previous harvest to this planting.
phenology | partial | fallback -- how many ends came from estimated dates.
Usable observations in the armor window. Under 3 gives no reading.
1 minus bare soil. GROUND COVER, not tillage. Provisional and uncalibrated.
Minimum and maximum across the window.
Living green cover fraction.
Crop residue fraction. A terminated cover crop lands here, not in f_pv.
Bare soil fraction. The three fractions sum to 1.
Minimum NDTI across the window. Reported, not used as a headline.
Median NDVI inside the armor window.
Blank when the reading is clean; otherwise why it is missing or qualified.
Fieldprint crop id for the cash crop.
Dates the grower entered. Compare against the _est columns.
Reported yield.
Tillage activities dated on or before cash planting.
Pipe-joined tillage_operation_ids. 95% of rows are the same pair.

yes where a planting_cover activity exists. not_recorded means an interval covered the year but held no cover crop activity -- this is NOT a confirmed negative; planting_cover appears only in 2026 intervals across the whole archive. Fieldprint cover crop id.
Sowing and termination dates the grower entered.
As entered.

How many of the 98 fields carry this exact entered planting date this year. Typically 30-65: the dates are templates, not per-field observations. A date error computed against them measures offset from a template, not accuracy.
Same, for harvest.
Same, for cover crop sowing. More varied than the cash crop dates but still clustered.
